findings: Checked and correct against the sources: (1) the ids table matches uvm-core 2020.3.1. uvm_sequencer_param_base::send_request sets transaction_id only when it is -1 and always calls set_sequence_id. uvm_transaction::do_copy copies no ids, and uvm_sequence_item has no do_copy, so m_sequence_id stays -1 on a clone. §14.1.2.4 is set_id_info. (2) The 13-step start() table matches uvm_sequence_base::start() line by line: try_get and SEQ_NOT_DONE, SEQPRI and the 100/parent priority, clear_response_queue then register, UVM_PRE_START before the fork, each #0, the raise and drop, pre_do/mid_do with no state change, UVM_ENDED then post_do, the SEQBDYZMB warning then kill(). §14.2.3.1 is correct. (3) Driver styles: uvm_sequencer::get is m_safe_select_item followed by item_done(), and finish_item is send_request followed by wait_for_item_done, so both rows (finish_item(A1) vs start_item(A2) at 5 ns) are right. (4) Response routing: depth is 8, the error flag starts at 0, and the put_base_response text 'Response queue overflow, response was dropped' is exact. m_use_response_handler defaults to 0. §14.2.7.1/.5/.6/.7 and §14.3.3.3 match the LRM. (5) Default sequence: Annex G.2.1 is +UVM_TESTNAME and G.2.9 is +uvm_set_default_sequence=<seqr>,<phase>,<type>. (6) Name capture: §18.7.1, and c_word_aligned and local::rd_addr exist in the lesson.
